name: Warm plate
intro: Something warm, something cold, something sharp, on one plate. Ground lamb or sliced pork makes it dinner; the flavor makes it different each time.
season_anchor: Ground lamb, browned with garlic and chile flakes — or leftover pork tenderloin, sliced

variations.context: The default. Dates and feta over the lamb, yogurt underneath.
Salted yogurt under everything, pomegranate over it.
Leftover slices warmed in the pan, ajvar spooned over.

finish: Brown all the lamb at once, hard, in a dry pan — let it sit until it crusts before you break it up — then add a grated garlic clove and a pinch of chile flakes for the last minute. Half goes on tonight's plate; the rest keeps four days for a second plate, toast, or the hash. Build each plate in layers: rice, warm squash and lamb, then the finish on top.
